name: castov_timestamp
description: Inspect and convert a Unix epoch timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) to UTC, ISO 8601, and localized human time.

value.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (10 digits) or milliseconds (13 digits), e.g. '1713456789'

name: castov_detect_id
description: Detect identifier format and decode embedded creation timestamp from MongoDB ObjectId, UUIDv7, ULID, or Twitter/Discord Snowflake ID.

id.description: Identifier string (UUIDv7, ULID, 24-hex ObjectId, or numeric Snowflake ID)

name: castov_cidr
description: Calculate IPv4 CIDR subnet mask, wildcard mask, network address, broadcast address, usable IP range, and total host count.

name: castov_port
description: Inspect network port number (1-65535) for standard IANA service assignment, transport protocol (TCP/UDP), and typical application purpose.

name: castov_cron
description: Parse a 5-field cron expression into plain English and calculate the next 5 upcoming execution times in a specified IANA timezone.

expression.description: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), e.g. '*/15 * * * *' or '0 9 * * 1-5'

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name (defaults to 'UTC', e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London')

name: castov_timezone
description: Convert a date/time string between two IANA time zones with exact UTC offset, timezone abbreviation, and Daylight Saving Time (DST) transition warnings.

dateTime.description: Date/time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' or ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2026-03-29 14:30'

name: castov_secret
description: Generate cryptographically secure random secrets (CSPRNG) in Hex, Base64URL, API Key ('sk_live_...'), and sortable UUIDv7 formats for .env files and JWT signing.

bytes.description: Optional entropy length in bytes between 8 and 512 (default: 32 bytes / 256 bits)

name: castov_jwt_decode
description: Decode a JSON Web Token (JWT) header and payload locally offline without external network calls, inspecting claims (exp, iat, nbf, sub, iss) and expiration status.

name: castov_hash
description: Compute deterministic cryptographic hashes (sha256, sha384, sha512, sha1, md5) and Base64 / Base64URL encodings of input text locally.

text.description: Input text string to hash and encode

name: castov_scan_secrets
description: Scan a code snippet, git diff, or .env configuration text locally for leaked credentials (AWS Access Keys, Stripe Live Keys, OpenAI API Keys, GitHub PATs, Slack Tokens, and RSA/OpenSSH Private Keys).

content.description: Code snippet, configuration file text, or git diff to audit for hardcoded secrets

name: castov_json_to_ts_pipeline
description: Full developer pipeline: validate JSON (raw or base64), format, analyze structure, and generate strongly-typed TypeScript interfaces.

json.description: JSON string or Base64-encoded JSON to convert

name: castov_cron_timezone_pipeline
description: Cron schedule & multi-timezone pipeline: explain cron expression and calculate next 5 upcoming executions simultaneously converted across UTC, Local, America/New_York (EST/EDT), Europe/Paris (CET/CEST), and Asia/Tokyo (JST).

name: castov_jwt_inspect_pipeline
description: Comprehensive JWT inspection pipeline: decode header & payload, check signature algorithm, evaluate timestamp claims (iat, exp, nbf), calculate remaining TTL, and detect security vulnerabilities.

name: castov_json_to_zod
description: Generate a deterministic Zod v4 or v3 validation schema from a JSON sample locally, inferring email, URL, ISO datetime, integer, and nested object types.

json.description: JSON string to convert into a Zod schema

zodVersion.description: Target Zod version ('v4' uses z.email()/z.url(), 'v3' uses z.string().email())

name: castov_env_to_zod
description: Convert a .env file content into a type-safe Zod v4/v3 schema or @t3-oss/env-nextjs env.ts configuration without exposing any secret values, and detect NEXT_PUBLIC_ secret leaks.

name: castov_sql_to_prisma
description: Convert SQL CREATE TABLE DDL statements into Prisma ORM models with inferred relations and native @db types.
